### 🐛 Describe the bug Serving a Qwen3.5-family multimodal model with MTP speculative decoding emits two misleading startup log lines about the **draft** model config, printed under the *target* model's name: ``` (APIServer pid=...) WARNING ... [registry.py:117] Model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 is treated as multimodal but has no registered multimodal processor; running in text-only mode. (APIServer pid=...) INFO ... [model.py:842] Disabled mm_prefix attention mode because multimodal inputs are configuration-disabled. Attention backends without mm_prefix support may now be selected. ``` There is no functional impact (verified below), but the lines falsely suggest multimodal support is degraded. **Steps to reproduce** (v0.27.1, 2x GPU; model `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8`, `architectures: ["Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration"]`, `model_type: "qwen3_5"`): ```bash # baseline: no such log lines vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --max-model-len 262144 \ --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --reasoning-parser qwen3 # adding MTP emits the two lines above vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --max-model-len 262144 \ --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --reasoning-parser qwen3 \ --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' ``` **Observed result** — log ordering shows the lines belong to the draft config, not the target: ``` INFO [model.py:645] Resolved architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration # target, no warnings INFO [model.py:645] Resolved architecture: Qwen3_5MTP # draft config WARNING [registry.py:117] Model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 is treated as multimodal but has no registered multimodal processor; running in text-only mode. INFO [model.py:842] Disabled mm_prefix attention mode because multimodal inputs are configuration-disabled. ... ``` **Expected behavior:** no warning — MTP draft classes never process raw multimodal inputs (they consume embeddings produced target-side), so a missing multimodal processor on the draft config is expected and should not be reported as a fallback. **Root cause** (v0.27.1 line numbers): 1. `SpeculativeConfig` builds a separate draft `ModelConfig` with `runner="draft"` reusing the target's model path (`vllm/config/speculative.py:842`); `hf_config_override` rewrites `architectures` to `["Qwen3_5MTP"]` for `model_type in ("qwen3_5", "qwen3_5_moe")` (`speculative.py:516-525`). 2. `Qwen3_5MTP` implements `SupportsMultiModal` (`vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_5_mtp.py:212`) — intentionally, because the draft merges multimodal embeddings from the target. Hence `_ModelInfo.supports_multimodal` is true and `ModelConfig.__post_init__` creates a `multimodal_config` for the draft (`vllm/config/model.py:725-768`), so `is_multimodal_model` is true. 3. Since #48796 every `ModelConfig` calls `MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.supports_multimodal_inputs()` via `get_model_arch_config` (`model.py:839`). For the draft config, `_get_model_cls` raises `ValueError` because `Qwen3_5MTP` has no `@register_processor` (`vllm/multimodal/registry.py:176-186`) → the warning is logged and `False` is returned → follow-up INFO at `model.py:842`. The check conflates *consumes multimodal embeddings* (true for these draft classes) with *needs a multimodal input processor* (never true for drafts; `vllm/v1/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py:148` already consults the **target** config for `supports_mm_inputs`). Scope: any MTP draft class implementing `SupportsMultiModal` without a registered processor — `Qwen3_5MTP`/`Qwen3_5MoeMTP` and the Exaone4.5 / MiMo-V2 MTP classes (same pattern). v0.27.1 is the first release where the path is reachable (#34110 added the interface flag, #35520 the warning text, #48796 connected the draft config to the check; still present on `main`). **Impact / verification** (2x RTX 5090, both deployments serving the model above): image requests succeed in both modes with semantically identical answers (both correctly read text embedded in a test image); MTP acceptance 83.4% (mean acceptance length 3.50). The target's mm_prefix bidirectional attention is unaffected (the runner reads the target config, `vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py:524`); `vllm/v1/spec_decode/dflash.py:89-90` even clears `is_mm_prefix_lm` on purpose for its draft path, so a text-only draft config is an accepted state. **Suggested fix directions:** - Preferred: don't create `multimodal_config` for draft runner configs (gate `model.py:725` on `runner_type != "draft"`) or skip/downgrade the `supports_multimodal_inputs` check for `runner_type == "draft"`. A grep shows no consumer of the draft config's multimodal state, and `runner_type` is resolved before the multimodal init block (`model.py:609`). - Alternative (larger): distinguish "supports multimodal embeddings" from "is a multimodal-input model" at the interface/registry level. Happy to submit a PR for the preferred direction if maintainers agree on the semantics. Note: root-cause analysis and on-box verification for this report were AI-assisted and reviewed by the filer. - [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the documentation page, which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
